notes.title: Patch v1.03
notes.content:
Thanks so much for playing the game! Here's another bunch of small fixes and improvements.

[b]1.03 fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Wall collisions are slightly less sticky, dash is no longer cancelled by the walls.
[*]Last comic now unlocks properly in the menu.
[*]F12 can now be used to take Steam screenshots.
[*]Using FFW no longer disqualifies the 200% speed challenge.
[*]Getting [spoiler]Antibodies[/spoiler] over 20 seconds no longer disqualifies a certain goal.
[*]Fix for [spoiler]??????? level Phantom Gatekeeper[/spoiler].
[*][spoiler]Trailblazer[/spoiler] now also works as a solution to a certain puzzle.
[*][spoiler]Something to do with the challenges.[/spoiler]
[*]Fix for people experiencing an error when using absorb.
[/list]

notes.title: Disc Room v1.02 has arrived in orbit of Jupiter
notes.content:
[b]1.02 fixes:[/b]
[list][*]You'll no longer get stuck in the wall using Slow.
[*]You'll be able to use Mirror when next to a wall.
[*]Fix for one of the ???????? rooms not unlocking.
[*]Fix for absorb not unlocking for some people.
[*]Fix for hard mode not unlocking for some people.
[*]Fix for the [spoiler]boss rush[/spoiler] ???????? room.
[*]Fix for splitter and clone disc exploits.
[*]UI sound for leaderboard page toggle.
[*]Improved blast collision.
[*]Small tweak to timeless.
[*]You'll no longer start hard mode with a best of 30 on the first room.
[*]Tweaked sound volumes for the first and final gatekeeper.
[*]Less than 30 deaths challenge will no longer show the wrong value.
[*]Gatekeeper phase 1 visual fix.
[*]Dash trail visual fix at higher game speeds.
[*]Final area performance improvements.
[*]Clone performance improvements.
[*]Door lock sound fix.[/list]
